description: Contract uses prose-based grading dimensions with numeric scores (>= 6/10 per dimension, >= 7.0/10 weighted total) instead of discrete CRIT-XXX criteria with binary PASS/FAIL verdicts. VCSDD strict mode requires binary-evaluable criteria. Phase 3 adversary cannot populate evaluatedCriteria in convergenceSignals because no CRIT-XXX identifiers exist. The pass threshold at line 72 ('Each dimension must score >= 6/10 and weighted total must be >= 7.0/10') allows grade inflation through partial credit.

evidence.snippet:
## Pass Threshold
Each dimension must score >= 6/10 and weighted total must be >= 7.0/10.

remediation: Replace the five prose grading dimensions with discrete CRIT-XXX criteria (one per reviewable obligation). Each criterion must have an explicit PASS/FAIL condition. Remove numeric scoring and weighted totals. Use binary pass threshold: overall PASS requires all criteria PASS.
